title: Medusa shop
description: Sales of the Medusa shop, read from its database (read-only account)

list.name: currency
list.label: Currency
list.query:
SELECT currency_code FROM "order" WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT is_draft_order
UNION
SELECT currency_code FROM cart WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY 1
list.definition: currencies of the orders and of the carts

panels.title: Orders

targets.rawSql:
WITH orders AS (
  SELECT o.id, o.version, o.display_id, o.status, o.created_at, o.shipping_address_id,
         (s.totals ->> 'current_order_total')::numeric AS total
  FROM "order" o
  JOIN order_summary s ON s.order_id = o.id AND s.version = o.version AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
  WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND NOT o.is_draft_order
    AND o.status <> 'canceled'
    AND o.currency_code = '$currency'
    AND $__timeFilter(o.created_at)
)
SELECT count(*) AS "Orders"
FROM orders

panels.description: Orders placed over the selected time range, drafts and canceled orders excluded.

panels.title: Items sold

targets.rawSql:
WITH orders AS (
  SELECT o.id, o.version, o.display_id, o.status, o.created_at, o.shipping_address_id,
         (s.totals ->> 'current_order_total')::numeric AS total
  FROM "order" o
  JOIN order_summary s ON s.order_id = o.id AND s.version = o.version AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
  WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND NOT o.is_draft_order
    AND o.status <> 'canceled'
    AND o.currency_code = '$currency'
    AND $__timeFilter(o.created_at)
)
SELECT coalesce(sum(i.quantity), 0) AS "Items sold"
FROM orders o
JOIN order_item i ON i.order_id = o.id AND i.version = o.version AND i.deleted_at IS NULL

panels.description: Number of items in the orders placed over the selected time range.

panels.title: Revenue ($currency)

panels.description: Sum of the current totals of the orders (items, shipping, taxes, after discounts), refunds not deducted.

panels.description: Average total of an order over the selected time range.

panels.title: Carts converted

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(completed_at)::float / nullif(count(*), 0) AS "Carts converted"
FROM cart
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
  AND currency_code = '$currency'
  AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.description: Share of the carts created over the selected time range that became an order. The storefront creates a cart when a visitor adds a first product.

panels.title: New customer accounts

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "New accounts"
FROM customer
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
  AND has_account
  AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.description: Customer accounts registered over the selected time range (guest checkouts are not accounts).

WITH orders AS (

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1d', 0), count(*) AS "Orders"

panels.title: Carts per day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1d', 0), count(*) AS "Carts created", count(completed_at) AS "Carts converted"
FROM cart
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
  AND currency_code = '$currency'
  AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Carts created each day, and how many of them became an order.

targets.rawSql:
WITH orders AS (
  SELECT o.id, o.version, o.display_id, o.status, o.created_at, o.shipping_address_id,
         (s.totals ->> 'current_order_total')::numeric AS total
  FROM "order" o
  JOIN order_summary s ON s.order_id = o.id AND s.version = o.version AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
  WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND NOT o.is_draft_order
    AND o.status <> 'canceled'
    AND o.currency_code = '$currency'
    AND $__timeFilter(o.created_at)
)
SELECT upper(coalesce(a.country_code, '?')) AS "Country", count(*) AS "Orders"
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN order_address a ON a.id = o.shipping_address_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Best-selling products (selected time range)

targets.rawSql:
WITH orders AS (
  SELECT o.id, o.version, o.display_id, o.status, o.created_at, o.shipping_address_id,
         (s.totals ->> 'current_order_total')::numeric AS total
  FROM "order" o
  JOIN order_summary s ON s.order_id = o.id AND s.version = o.version AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
  WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND NOT o.is_draft_order
    AND o.status <> 'canceled'
    AND o.currency_code = '$currency'
    AND $__timeFilter(o.created_at)
)
SELECT coalesce(li.product_title, li.title) AS "Product",
       sum(i.quantity) AS "Quantity",
       sum(i.quantity * coalesce(i.unit_price, li.unit_price)) AS "Amount"
FROM orders o
JOIN order_item i ON i.order_id = o.id AND i.version = o.version AND i.deleted_at IS NULL
JOIN order_line_item li ON li.id = i.item_id AND li.deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC, 3 DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.description: Quantity sold per product, and amount (unit price x quantity, before discounts and taxes).

panels.title: Latest orders (selected time range)

targets.rawSql:
WITH orders AS (
  SELECT o.id, o.version, o.display_id, o.status, o.created_at, o.shipping_address_id,
         (s.totals ->> 'current_order_total')::numeric AS total
  FROM "order" o
  JOIN order_summary s ON s.order_id = o.id AND s.version = o.version AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
  WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND NOT o.is_draft_order
    AND o.status <> 'canceled'
    AND o.currency_code = '$currency'
    AND $__timeFilter(o.created_at)
)
SELECT o.display_id AS "Order", o.created_at AS "Date", o.status AS "Status", o.total AS "Total",
       upper(a.country_code) AS "Country"
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN order_address a ON a.id = o.shipping_address_id
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
LIMIT 20
